# Description

This script will generate the following plots and tables:

\- Fig 2 b, d, c, j

\- Supp Table 1

# 0) Preparations

## load libraries

```{r message=FALSE}
#| label: libraries
library(edgeR) 
library(PCAtools)
library(sva)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(BayesPrism)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)

```

## new folders

```{r}
#| label: folders
plot_dir <- "Paper_Figures"
if (!file.exists(plot_dir)) {
    dir.create(plot_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
}

table_dir <- "Paper_Tables"
if (!file.exists(table_dir)) {
    dir.create(table_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = FALSE)
}
```

## loading all the data

### original data

```{r}
#| label: data
all_counts_orig <- read.delim("3574F_raw_counts.uniqueID.20260730.tab")
rownames(all_counts_orig) <- all_counts_orig$uniqueID

# exclude day 10
all_counts_orig_selected <- all_counts_orig[,c(1:12,15:21,24:30)]
colnames(all_counts_orig_selected)
```

### new data

```{r}
#| label: new data
all_counts_new <- read.delim("4299F_raw_counts.uniqueID.20260730.tab")
rownames(all_counts_new) <- all_counts_new$uniqueID
# exclude day 10
all_counts_new_selected <- all_counts_new[,c(1:12,15:21,24:30)]
colnames(all_counts_new_selected)
```

### combine

```{r}
#| label: combine data
identical(rownames(all_counts_orig_selected),rownames(all_counts_new_selected))

all_counts_selected <- cbind(all_counts_orig_selected,all_counts_new_selected[,-c(1:5)])
colnames(all_counts_selected)

# fix order of day 8 in Z149
all_counts_selected <- all_counts_selected[,c(1:45,47,46)]
colnames(all_counts_selected)
```

## set up metadata

```{r}
#| label: metadata
# Get only the sample columns
sample_cols <- colnames(all_counts_selected)[6:ncol(all_counts_selected)]

# Donor to sex mapping
donor_sex <- c(
  "X113" = "female",
  "Y031" = "female",
  "X087" = "male",
  "Z143" = "male",
  "Z107" = "male",
  "Z149" = "female"
)

# Create metadata
metadata <- data.frame(
  donor = sub("_.*", "", sample_cols),
  #number = seq(133, by=1, length.out = length(sample_cols)),  # adjust start number if needed
  time = as.numeric(sub(".*_(\\d+)d_.*", "\\1", sample_cols)),
  media = sub(".*_(MG|SP)$", "\\1", sample_cols),
  oxygen = "21p",
  mf = donor_sex[sub("_.*", "", sample_cols)],
  sample = paste0("X", seq(1, length(sample_cols)))
)

# Set rownames as the sample column names
rownames(metadata) <- sample_cols

# Add the time.char column as a character type
metadata <- data.frame(metadata,
                       time.char = as.character(metadata$time))
#make a factor for metadata_all$time.char
metadata$time.char <- factor(metadata$time.char, levels = c("1", "2", "3", "5","6","7","8"))

metadata <- data.frame(metadata,
                       time.med = paste(metadata$media, metadata$time))

# Make a factor for metadata$time.char with specific levels
metadata$time.med <- factor(metadata$time.med, levels = c("MG 5", "MG 6", "MG 7", "MG 8","SP 1", "SP 2", "SP 3"))

# View metadata
metadata
```

# 1) DGE: MG versus SP at individual (time) points

## prepare the metadata

```{r}
donor = metadata$donor
media = metadata$media
time = metadata$time
```

## generate DGEList object

We work with the raw counts

```{r}
#| label: DGE
all_counts_selected.asDGEList <- DGEList(counts=all_counts_selected[,-c(1:5)],genes=all_counts_selected[,c(1:5)])
```

### filter lowly expressed genes

We have 6 replicas (aka donors)

```{r}
#| label: filtering
mincpm <- 1 
minsamples <- 6  

all_counts_selected.asDGEList.cpm <- edgeR::cpm(all_counts_selected.asDGEList, log = FALSE)

all_counts_selected.asDGEList <- all_counts_selected.asDGEList[rowSums(all_counts_selected.asDGEList.cpm > mincpm) >= minsamples, , keep.lib.size=FALSE] 
```

### normalization

```{r}
#| label: normalization
all_counts_selected.asDGEList <- calcNormFactors(all_counts_selected.asDGEList)   # same as normLibSizes(y) 
head(all_counts_selected.asDGEList$samples) 
plotMDS(all_counts_selected.asDGEList)
```

## setting up the design matrix

day 5

```{r}
MG.21p.5 <- media== "MG" & time == "5"
```

day 6

```{r}
MG.21p.6 <- media== "MG" & time == "6"
SP.21p.1 <- media== "SP" & time == "1"
```

day 7

```{r}
MG.21p.7 <- media== "MG" & time == "7"
SP.21p.2 <- media== "SP" & time == "2"
```

day 8

```{r}
MG.21p.8 <- media== "MG" & time == "8"
SP.21p.3 <- media== "SP" & time == "3"
```

use model.matrix (do not include MG.21p.5)

```{r}
#| label: design
design <- model.matrix(~donor+MG.21p.6+ SP.21p.1+
                              MG.21p.7+ SP.21p.2+
                              MG.21p.8+ SP.21p.3)

rownames(design) <- colnames(all_counts_selected.asDGEList)
design
```

## dispersion estimation and fitting

```{r}
#| label: dispersion
all_counts_selected.asDGEList.disp <- estimateDisp(all_counts_selected.asDGEList, design, robust = TRUE)
all_counts_selected.asDGEList.disp$common.dispersion

plotBCV(all_counts_selected.asDGEList.disp)
```

```{r}
#| label: fitting
fit <- glmQLFit(all_counts_selected.asDGEList.disp, design)

plotQLDisp(fit)
```

## Differential expression: Day 8 MG versus Day 8(3) SP

```{r}
#| label:  differential expression
(colnames(design) == "SP.21p.3TRUE") * 1  + (colnames(design) == "MG.21p.8TRUE") * -1

qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast=as.vector((colnames(design) == "SP.21p.3TRUE") * 1  + (colnames(design) == "MG.21p.8TRUE") * -1) )

summary(decideTests(qlf))
summary(decideTests(qlf, p.value = 0.05, lfc = 1))

plotMD(qlf)
abline(h=c(-1, 1), col="blue")

topTags(qlf)
```

### define up and down regulated genes

```{r}
#| label: Supp Table 1

tt <- as.data.frame(topTags(qlf, n = nrow(all_counts_selected.asDGEList)))

# modify the status column based on logFC and FDR
tt_modified <- tt %>%
  mutate(status = factor(case_when(
    logFC > 1 & FDR < 0.05 ~ "up",
    logFC < (-1) & FDR < 0.05 ~ "down",
    TRUE ~ "ns"
  ), levels = c("up", "ns", "down")))


write.csv(tt_modified, file = paste0(table_dir, "/Table_S1.csv"), row.names = FALSE)


# filter the data to exclude 'ns' status
tt_filtered <- tt_modified %>% filter(status != "ns")

```

### volcano plot

figure 2 d

```{r}
#| label: Fig 2 d

# Create the volcano plot with -log10(PValue) on the y-axis
vplot <- ggplot(tt_modified, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(PValue), color = status)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("firebrick", "grey", "dodgerblue")) +
  ggtitle("SP vs MG; abs(logFC) > 1, logCPM > 1, PValue < 0.05") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 25, face = "bold.italic"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 22, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 18)) +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2))) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.010844), linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -1, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
 
geom_label_repel(
  data = tt_modified %>% 
    filter(SYMBOL %in% c("CDH3","FRAS1", "FREM2","LGR5","ADAMTS19","IFITM1","OASL",
                         "ERVV-1","HSD3B1","CGB3", "CYP11A1","CGB5","HSD17B1", "CSH1, CSHL1","LHB","AQP3", "PGF","CGB8","CGB2",
                         "CCL5","STAT1","IRF7","ISG15","IFIT1")),
  aes(label = SYMBOL),
  size = 7,
                   box.padding = 0.5,
                   point.padding = 0.5,
                   max.overlaps = Inf,
                   segment.color = 'grey50'
  )


# display (and save) the plot
print(vplot)


tiff(paste0(plot_dir, "/Figure_2_D.tiff"), width = 9, height = 7, units = "in", res = 300)
    print(vplot)
dev.off()
```

# 2) PCA

## Batch correction by donor using ComBat-seq

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| label: batch correction
all_counts_selected.CBSeq_byD <- ComBat_seq(as.matrix(all_counts_selected[,-c(1:5)]), batch=metadata$donor, group=NULL)
row.names(all_counts_selected.CBSeq_byD) <- row.names(all_counts_selected)
```

## PCA

PCA of batch corrected samples of a timecourse of apical-in vs apical-out analysed by bulk RNA sequencing, coloured by time and apical conformation (n=6 independent organoid lines). figure 2 b

```{r}
#| label: Fig 2 b
custom_colors <- c("MG 5" = '#C4DEE6',
                   "MG 6" = '#5FC5E4',
                   "MG 7" = '#1E90FF',
                   "MG 8" = '#00008F',

  "SP 1" = "#F08BC4", 
  "SP 2" = "#E6007E",  
  "SP 3" = "#7A004B"
)


all_counts_selected.bc.cpm.pca <- pca(edgeR::cpm(all_counts_selected.CBSeq_byD, log=TRUE), 
                              metadata = metadata, removeVar = 0.1)





# Create the biplot with custom colors
PCA <- biplot(all_counts_selected.bc.cpm.pca, 
       colby = "time.med",
       legendPosition = 'right',
       title = "PCA",
       encircle = FALSE, 
       lab = NULL,
       pointSize = 7.5,
       colkey = custom_colors)

#Remove the unnecessary fill label
PCA <- PCA + labs(fill = NULL)
# display (and save) the plot
PCA

tiff(paste0(plot_dir, "/Figure_2_B.tiff"), width = 9, height = 9, units = "in", res = 300)
print(PCA)
dev.off()
```

## 4) Deconvolution

Deconvolution of the bulk RNA sequencing using:

- single cell data: "Wang 2024 data" ("early" data set, only eCTB, eCTB_fusion and eSTB)

```{r}
sc_data_file <- "sc_data/placenta.rna.8w_rna.20260730.as_sce.with_add_paper_clusters.20260730.eCTB_eSTB_only.rds"
# This dataset is available on zenodo: 10.5281/zenodo.23387786
```

```{r}
#| label: directories
date()
today<- format(Sys.Date(), format="%Y%m%d")

directory <- paste("deconvolution.BayesPrism.Wang2024.",today, sep = "")
if (!file.exists(directory)) {
  dir.create(file.path(getwd(), directory))
}
```

## getting the data

### select apical-in (day 8 matrigel) and apical-out (day 3 supsension) end points

```{r}
#| label: selection

selected_counts <- all_counts_selected[,c(grep("8d_MG",colnames(all_counts_selected)),grep("3d_SP",colnames(all_counts_selected)))]
colnames(selected_counts)
```

### transpose bulk data

from the vignete: bk.dat : The sample-by-gene raw count matrix of bulk RNA-seq expression. rownames are bulk sample IDs, while colnames are gene names/IDs.

```{r}
#| label: transpose bulk data
bk.dat <- t(selected_counts)
bk.dat[,1:5]
```

![](images/clipboard-9133593.png)

## get sc/snRNA-seq data

```{r}
#| label: scdata 
sce <- readRDS(sc_data_file)
sce 
table(sce$paper_clusters) 
table(sce$paper_clusters_name)
```

### convert to (dense) matrix (and transpose)

```{r}
#| label: convert to matrix 
sc.dat <- t(as.matrix(assay(sce)))  
dim(sc.dat) 
head(rownames(sc.dat)) 
head(colnames(sc.dat))
```

## compare gene identifiers

```{r}
#| label: gene identifiers 
length(colnames(sc.dat)) 
length(colnames(bk.dat)) 
sum(colnames(sc.dat) %in% colnames(bk.dat)) 
sum(colnames(bk.dat) %in% colnames(sc.dat))
```

```{r}
colnames(colData(sce))
```

### generate BP cell.type.labels

```{r}
#| label: cell type labels
cell.type.labels <- as.character(colData(sce)[,"paper_clusters_name"])
table(cell.type.labels)
```

### generate cell.state.labels

from the vignette: Define multiple cell states for cell types of significant heterogeneity, such as malignant cells, and of interest to deconvolve their transcription. this is currently not the case fo now use: cell.state.labels \<- cell.type.labels see: https://github.com/Danko-Lab/BayesPrism/issues/66

```{r}
#| label: cell state labels
cell.state.labels <- as.character(colData(sce)[,"paper_clusters_name"])

table(cbind.data.frame(cell.state.labels, cell.type.labels))

```

## QC of cell type and state labels

```{r}
#| label: QC
plot.cor.phi (input=sc.dat, 
              input.labels=cell.state.labels,
              title="cell state (aka 'cell_type') correlation",
              cexRow=0.2, cexCol=0.2,
              margins=c(2,2)
)

# this is the same in our case
plot.cor.phi (input=sc.dat, 
              input.labels=cell.type.labels,
              title="cell type (aka 'cell_type') correlation",
              cexRow=0.5, cexCol=0.5,
)

```

## Filter outlier genes and select marker genes

### filtering

```{r}

#| label: outliers I
sc.stat <- plot.scRNA.outlier(input=sc.dat, 
                              cell.type.labels=cell.type.labels,
                              species="hs", 
                              return.raw=TRUE
)

head(sc.stat)
```

```{r}

#| label: outliers II
bk.stat <- plot.bulk.outlier(bulk.input=bk.dat,
                             sc.input=sc.dat, 
                             cell.type.labels=cell.type.labels,
                             species="hs",
                             return.raw=TRUE
)

head(bk.stat)
```

```{r}

#| label: filter
sc.dat.filtered <- cleanup.genes (input=sc.dat, 
                                  input.type="count.matrix",
                                  species="hs",
                                  gene.group=c("Rb","Mrp","other_Rb","chrM","MALAT1","chrX","chrY"), 
                                  exp.cells=5)

dim(sc.dat.filtered)
```

## marker genes

```{r}

#| label: select marker genes 
# performing pair-wise t test for cell states from different cell types
diff.exp.stat <- get.exp.stat(sc.dat=sc.dat[,colSums(sc.dat>0)>3],
                              cell.type.labels=cell.type.labels,
                              cell.state.labels=cell.state.labels,
                              pseudo.count=0.1, 
                              cell.count.cutoff=50, 
                              n.cores=1 
)

sc.dat.filtered.sig <- select.marker (sc.dat=sc.dat.filtered, 
                                      stat=diff.exp.stat,
                                      pval.max=0.01,
                                      lfc.min=0.1)

dim(sc.dat.filtered.sig)
```

## run BayesPrism

### construct prism object

```{r}

#| label: construct prism object
# use key=NULL
# see: https://github.com/Danko-Lab/BayesPrism/issues/69
myPrism <- new.prism( reference=sc.dat.filtered.sig, 
                      mixture=bk.dat, 
                      input.type="count.matrix", 
                      cell.type.labels = cell.type.labels, 
                      cell.state.labels = cell.state.labels, 
                      key=NULL,
                      outlier.cut=0.01,
                      outlier.fraction=0.1,
)
```

### Run BayesPrism

```{r}

#| label: Run BayesPrism
bp.res <- run.prism(prism = myPrism, n.cores=24)
bp.res
file_name <- paste(directory,"/bp.res.",today,".rds",sep = "")
saveRDS(bp.res, file = file_name)
```

## extract results

```{r}

#| label: Extract results
theta <- get.fraction (bp=bp.res,
                       #bp=bp.res.restored, 
                       which.theta="final",
                       state.or.type="type")
head(theta)
file_name <- paste(directory,"/BayesPrism_any.",today,".theta.tab",sep = "")
write.table(cbind(rownames(theta),theta), file = file_name,quote = FALSE,row.names = FALSE, sep = "\t")
```

Figure 2 j

```{r}

# Generate plotting data frame from theta

for (i in colnames(theta)) {

df2plot <- data.frame(

  cell_type = foo

# Match sample ordering used previously ("ordered by donor")
df2plot$samples <- factor(
  df2plot$samples,
  levels = rownames(theta)[c(1,7,2,8,3,9,4,10,5,11,6,12)]
)

# Colours and ordering
cell_cols <- c(
  # STB lineage
  "eSTB nascent"        = "#FDE0DD",
  "eSTB premature 2"    = "#FCC5C0",
  "eSTB premature 1"    = "#FA9FB5",
  "eSTB mixed"          = "#F768A1",
  "eSTB mature 2"       = "#C51B8A",
  "eSTB mature 1"       = "#7A0177",
  
  # Fusion
  "eCTB fusion"         = "#41AE76",
  
  # CTB lineage
  "eCTB proliferation"  = "#BDD7E7",
  "eCTB 2"              = "#6BAED6",
  "eCTB 1"              = "#2171B5"
)

celltype_order <- c(
  "eSTB mature 1",
  "eSTB mature 2",
  "eSTB mixed",
  "eSTB premature 1",
  "eSTB premature 2",
  "eSTB nascent",
  "eCTB fusion",
  "eCTB 1",
  "eCTB 2",
  "eCTB proliferation"
)

df2plot$celltype <- factor(df2plot$cell_type, levels = celltype_order)

df2plot$donor <- factor(
  unlist(strsplit(as.character(df2plot$samples), "_"))[c(TRUE, FALSE, FALSE)],
  levels = c("X113", "Y031", "X087", "Z143", "Z107", "Z149")
)

df2plot$time.med <- factor(
  unlist(strsplit(as.character(df2plot$samples), "_"))[c(FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)],
  levels = c("8d", "3d")
)

# Donor-faceted bar plot
p.bar <- ggplot(df2plot, aes(x = time.med, y = prop, fill = celltype)) +
  geom_col() +
  facet_wrap(~ donor, nrow = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cell_cols) +
  theme_bw()

p.bar

tiff_name <- paste(
  plot_dir,
  "/Figure_2_J.tiff",
  sep = ""
)

tiff(
  filename = tiff_name,
  width = 10,
  height = 7,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

print(p.bar)

dev.off()
```
